summary: Wiznote is a proprietary knowledge management system designed for organising documents within a folder hierarchy. It supports Markdown editing, full-text search capabilities, and the collection of content directly from web pages.
goodFor: It is suited for individuals or teams looking for a self-hosted platform to centralise notes and web clippings in one structured archive.
watchOut: The software is proprietary and lacks public development activity or version history, which introduces risks regarding long-term maintenance and security updates.
deployNotes: Since it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your document storage and set up a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
